code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_sep = [(i, row[0]) for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_sep = [(j, grid[0][j]) for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_colors = {v for _, v in row_sep + col_sep}
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in sep_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs = [i for i, _ in row_sep]; cs = [j for j, _ in col_sep]
    r_edges = [0] + [i+1 for i in rs] + [h]
    c_edges = [0] + [j+1 for j in cs] + [w]
    rb = [(r_edges[k], (rs+[h])[k]) for k in range(len(rs)+1)]
    cb = [(c_edges[k], (cs+[w])[k]) for k in range(len(cs)+1)]
    src = None
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(rb):
        for ci,(x,y) in enumerate(cb):
            if any(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)):
                src=(ri,ci,a,b,x,y); break
        if src: break
    if src is None: return out
    _,_,a,b,x,y=src
    for u,v in rb:
        for p,q in cb:
            if v-u != b-a or q-p != y-x: continue
            for dr in range(b-a):
                for dc in range(y-x): out[u+dr][p+dc]=grid[a+dr][x+dc]
    return out
'''
